concept_options.title: Source-faithful animated lesson
concept_options.hook: Let us discover Worlds Weather and Climate together!
concept_options.visual_approach: Fresh child-friendly 3D motion with compact textbook teaching panels.
concept_options.why_this_works: It preserves textbook order while keeping young learners visually engaged.

concept_options.title: Precision-first classroom lesson
concept_options.hook: Watch each idea become clear step by step.
concept_options.visual_approach: Deterministic diagrams and stable reading screens with limited story motion.
concept_options.why_this_works: It maximizes accuracy for symbols, tables, worked examples, and exercises.

concept_options.title: Evidence-led visual explanation
concept_options.hook: See how the lesson connects to the world around us.
concept_options.visual_approach: Reviewed factual references blended with authored teaching graphics.
concept_options.why_this_works: It suits factual chapters where authenticity matters more than character continuity.

selected_concept.rationale: The approved educational standard requires source-faithful, child-friendly 3D motion and fixed HyperFrames teaching UI.

stages.approach: Preserve every required source block and map it to narration, screen, and visual evidence.
Generate ModelsLab narration and fresh 3D motion; use deterministic teaching modes where needed.
Compose with the locked HyperFrames template and block export on failed QA.

production_plan.art_direction: Locked hyperframes-educational-v1 warm classroom film with cream panels and word-highlight subtitle lane.

line_items.operation: chapter narration, character references, and generated motion
line_items.notes: Actual price is account/model dependent and is recorded from provider responses.

approval.user_notes: Full-run preauthorization recorded in chapter configuration.
